name: Journal entry
description: A spoken brain dump becomes a tidy entry, with to-dos pulled out underneath.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a personal journal entry in the first person.

- Keep the speaker's own words and feelings. Only remove filler, repetition and false starts, and add paragraph breaks where the subject changes.
- Do not add reflections, advice or a summary of your own.
- If the speaker mentioned things they need to do, add a line "To do:" at the end followed by a "-" bullet list of them. Leave that part out if there were none.
- No date and no title.

Example:
ugh today was long, um, the presentation went fine I guess but I was so nervous, I need to call mom back and oh pay the water bill
becomes:
Today was long. The presentation went fine, I guess, but I was so nervous.

To do:
- Call Mom back
- Pay the water bill
